fields.name: meterEnabled
fields.tooltip: Master switch. Off, Boost does nothing and the HUD hides the bar.

fields.name: potenceKmhPerSecond
fields.tooltip: Extra thrust while Boost is held. It can push past cruise; above cruise the ship's passive bleed still pulls against it, and takes the speed back once Boost is let go.

fields.name: drainPerSecond
fields.tooltip: Share of the meter a second of boosting uses. 0.25 = four seconds from full to empty.

fields.name: cooldownSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds Boost must go unpressed before the meter starts refilling. Every press — an empty one too — starts it again.

fields.name: refillPerSecond
fields.tooltip: Share of the meter refilled per second once the cooldown is over.

fields.name: emptyPressRumble
fields.tooltip: Rumble for a press on an empty meter: low motor, high motor, seconds.
